notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/LSDU5Mb.png

Change log:

Better GUI scaling on high resolution screens.
Can not click "through" the GUI and click a level at the same time anymore.
Other minor GUI tweaks.
Changed the camera so it doesn't center on a bird when clicking stuff.
Undo no longer change which bird is selected.
Undo shortcut on the mouse changed from Mouse4 to Mouse3 (the scroll wheel).
Fruits no longer flicker when pressing Undo.
Again, possibly some stuff we forgot about.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 is live!
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/LSDU5Mb.png
Change log:

 Added remappable keys.
 Added a "High Quality" checkbox under Screen Settings.
 Removed the diagonal-move bug.
 Properly removed the Redo (E) command. It was never supposed to be there in the first place (hence the bugs). It may be finished up and reintroduced in the future if it's missed.
 Fixed a crash related to the grid.
 Curious George can now be completed, sorry about that. The letters on the title screen counted as something else rather than themselves. Click them again.
 Fixed a broken clickable (the box on level 27).
 The menu now displays what level you're playing.
 The splash screen now obeys your sound settings.
 Possibly a few extremely minor and forgotten changes.
